stamp: {"keys":[{"id":"k","problem":"The page says its data is updated monthly, yet the figures are as of September, in November.","where":"the data date at the top","kind":"general"}],"liked":[]}

raised: The word "חשיפה" (exposure) in the introduction put the reader off
The "123 מקור / מחושב / הזנה" line was confusing and seemed pointless
The yellow warning says the data hasn't been updated since September, but the bottom says data as of 3 November, so which date is right?
"מבטיח תשואה" (guaranteed return) is confusing because it always shows "לא דווח", and it's unclear whether one can join
The "הלכה יהודית" and "אג"ח ממשלות" filter buttons were confusing
Had to scroll past dozens of irrelevant S&P 500, shares and IRA rows (would remove them)
Didn't know what the fund (קופה) number with the little arrow is
Didn't understand מט"ח or whether the yellow ring is good or bad (would remove the line)
Unclear difference between the fee from savings and the fee from deposits, and which matters at 61
Share exposure above 100% (101–103%) makes no sense
Infinity's negative deposit fee (−0.21%) has a warning icon and no explanation
Unclear what the self-managed track is and whether it suits them
Some track names seem cut off (start with "ולפיצויים...")
Fees are averages, and the page doesn't say what fee they would actually pay or whether it can be negotiated
No information on the cost, tax or timing of moving money between companies
No return after fees shown
No worst-year or loss figure for the over-60 tracks
No information on when or how they can withdraw (lump sum or pension)
No information on whether they'd be moved to another track automatically with age
No side-by-side summary of only the over-60 tracks
Brand-new tracks with "עוד לא דווח" and ₪0 managed should be dropped
The coloured rings are unnecessary and should be dropped

problems.why: Item 3 is the same problem: the reader was worried that the warning dates the figures to September even though the page is dated November. That stale-data contradiction is the core of the person's complaint.
